newsitem.title: USA: Colombia to retender up to 50,000 T rice - trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombia to retender up to 50,000 T rice - trade.

text.p: Colombia is expected to retender for up to 50,000 tonnes optional origin rice this week after passing last Friday, U.S. exporters and traders said.
One U.S. exporter said Colombia may reschedule the tender on Monday for 50,000 tonnes optional origin rice which could be be U.S. or Argentinian for March/April shipment.

But one trader said he heard different reports on the quantity. The tender could be for 36,000 tonnes rough rice or 24,000 tonnes milled rice but it could also be for 50,000 tonnes optional origin rough or milled rice, he said.
"Colombia has basically passed since there were no import licenses issued. But as of Friday, I have not heard of any retendering or rescheduling," another U.S. trader said.
"I have not checked this morning (Monday)," he added.

Last week, the head of Colombia's National Rice Growers' Association, Rafael Hernandez, said his country faces a shortfall of up to 60,000 tonnes of rice this year and the deficit will have to be covered through imports.
